title: Cao Cao Mobility Launches AI Ride-Hailing Service in Collaboration with Doubao, First Launched in Beijing, Hangzhou, and Suzhou

content_html:
AI ride-hailing service jointly launched by Cao Cao Mobility and Doubao is now available in Beijing, Hangzhou, and Suzhou. When users consult about routes, locations, dining, entertainment, and other local lifestyle information within Doubao, the system can generate travel plans based on the conversation content and directly connect to Cao Cao Mobility's ride-hailing service.

Cao Cao Mobility stated that in the future, both parties will further expand AI travel functions such as smart vehicle control, replicate relevant services to more cities, and continue to explore Robotaxi capabilities.
